name: CAP service cap insignia, officers (men's and women's service caps)
size_basis: Scaled from Fig A5-8: the device is ~90 px wide against the 7.4 in cap band (300 px) drawn on the same page, ~2.2 in; height from the device figure aspect (about 1.04 wide : 1 tall). The regulation gives no dimension.
provenance: CAPR 39-1 3 Mar 2020 Fig A5-8 (p.138, CAP DEVICES row; A5-9 shows the same devices on the women's caps); source figure is ~190 px of faint grey embossing: outline and large shading traced, no feather or leaf detail; CAP disc / shield and triangle are parametric

mounts.uniform: Men's service cap (Fig A5-8) and women's service cap (Fig A5-9)
mounts.rule: centred on the front of the cap, in device_slot_center of the hat asset, with the clouds and darts for grade on the visor (6.2.1.1.1, 6.2.1.2.1)

documented: officers (and NCOs per ICL 25-02, who wear the NCO device) wear the CAP service cap insignia centred on the front of the cap (6.2.1.1.1, 6.2.1.2.1)
